description: Near-identical to the seed-trial write-up but with no frame: a bare 'my favorite part', a bare 'the most surprising result' and a mid-sentence casual 'Honestly'. All are the author's own stance in a casual voice, so the right answer is no edit and the file comes back essentially identical.
prompt: Check trial.md for AI-sounding phrasing and fix whatever needs it. It's a season write-up for our allotment newsletter. Save the result to out/trial.md.

files.trial.md:
We planted 24 beds in the Alder Lane seed trial between April and June, and 17 gave a harvest.

The bean trellis was my favorite part of the season. The most surprising result was the purple kale, which out-yielded the spinach in every bed except the shaded ones. Honestly, I would not repeat the carrot rows. Bed 9 flooded twice and we lost it.
